state.project: Miu World: voxel learning game for Vietnamese grade-2 children, web, target iPad Gen 10, built 100% by AI. Owner's one wish: lively, children never bored.
state.owner_opinion: The owner finds the maps a bit small and would like them several times bigger, done now so it does not need much rework later; the owner leaves the decision to Jev.
state.earlier_decision: An hour ago Jev chose to keep the school map at 96x96 when told a bigger map carried an iPad performance risk. That risk was overstated: measured facts below.

facts.maps: Two playable maps, both 96x96 blocks and 32 high: Khu rừng bí mật (34 Tiếng Việt lessons, chapter 1 hand-built) and Trường học (36 Toán lessons in 7 topic zones), being rebuilt now from the owner's campus mocks. A child crosses a 96 map in about 25 seconds of walking.
facts.rendering: Only chunks within the view distance are drawn (40 blocks at low quality, 64 mid, 110 high), so per-frame draw calls depend on the view distance, not the map size; the draw-call budget (<=150) holds on a bigger map. Villagers and animals are already limited to the nearest few.
facts.costs: Voxel data 1.2 MB in memory for 192x32x192; download grows from about 25 KB to about 100 KB per map; meshing at load grows with the map (4x the chunks for 192); walking between places takes longer, the quest arrow already guides the child.
facts.height: 32 blocks high limits the school's clock tower (its roof peak is at the top now); 48 high would leave room for taller buildings, trees and hills.
facts.rework: The map generators place quest targets from data into zones; their layouts use fixed coordinates, so the size should be settled now and the layouts written against it.

map_size.instructions: Which size should every playable map be built at from now on, weighing the owner's wish for several times bigger maps against load time and walking distance on an iPad?

height.instructions: How high should the maps be?

criteria.height_48: 48 blocks high, room for taller buildings, trees and hills.

which_maps.instructions: Which maps should be enlarged in this batch?

criteria.both_now: Both the school map (being rebuilt now) and the forest map, so neither needs reworking later.
